name: Sum Over Subsets
description: You are given a multiset $$$S$$$. Over all pairs of subsets $$$A$$$ and $$$B$$$, such that: $$$B \subset A$$$; $$$|B| = |A| - 1$$$; greatest common divisor of all elements in $$$A$$$ is equal to one; find the sum of $$$\sum_{x \in A}{x} \cdot \sum_{x \in B}{x}$$$, modulo $$$998\,244\,353$$$.
input_specification: The first line contains one integer $$$m$$$ ($$$1 \le m \le 10^5$$$): the number of different values in the multiset $$$S$$$. Each of the next $$$m$$$ lines contains two integers $$$a_i$$$, $$$freq_i$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^5, 1 \le freq_i \le 10^9$$$). Element $$$a_i$$$ appears in the multiset $$$S$$$ $$$freq_i$$$ times. All $$$a_i$$$ are different.
approach_summary: Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N using Fermat's Little Theorem (mod 10^9+7 or 998244353). Answer nCr queries in O(1) time per query.
